title: Vinyl-Mind
intro: Vinyl-Mind lets several stations learn together: each turntable profile shares only the coefficients and counts of its learning model, never audio. The shared model comes back and is only used where it does not estimate worse on your own master recordings.
contribute_help: After each retraining, send the coefficients and counts of every turntable profile (see What is sent). Never during a recording.
contribute_off: Contributing is off. Nothing is sent.
use_help: Fetch the shared model, check it on your master recordings and use it as the starting point of the training where it does not make the estimate worse.
use_on: The global model is fetched and checked.
use_off: The global model is no longer used.
url_reset_done: Server address reset to the default.
check_server_hint: Asks the server for its key and how stations join. Nothing is sent about this station.
client_not_accepted: This server does not accept {client}. Please update vinyl-check before connecting.
feature_unsupported_server: This server does not combine this station's feature version yet. You can connect, but nothing is contributed until it does.
clock_warning: The clock of this computer is about {s} seconds off from the server's. Please correct the time; the server refuses requests more than five minutes off.
connect_hint: Opens {site} in your browser. Sign in, confirm this station, and you are brought back here automatically.
connect_hint_device: Shows a short code. Open {site} on your phone or another computer, sign in and confirm the code.
where_code: Where do I get a code?
where_code_text: From the operator of this server. Whoever runs a Vinyl-Mind server hands out invitation codes, one per station. Paste it here; it is used once and never stored.
where_code_approval: From the operator of this server. Without a code, the station waits until the operator approves it; with one, it is admitted at once. A code is used once and never stored.
where_code_link: Get a code from the operator
fingerprint_confirm: The server key above matches the fingerprint the operator publishes
fingerprint_confirm_first: Compare the server key with the fingerprint the operator publishes and confirm it first.
join_no_url: Enter and save a server address first.
joined_pending: Registered. The operator still has to approve this station.
browser_waiting: Sign in at {site} in your browser and confirm this station. This page updates by itself.
browser_no_callback: Nothing happens after confirming? A firewall or another browser may keep the page from coming back. Use a code instead.
browser_open_link: Open the sign-in page with the link below.
device_intro: Open {site} on your phone or another computer, sign in and confirm this code. Or scan the QR code.
device_waiting: Waiting for the confirmation. This page updates by itself.
connect_retry: Signed in. The server does not admit the station yet; it tries again by itself (next try: {time}).
pending_hint: The operator of the server still has to approve this station. This page checks every few seconds.
client_rejected: The server no longer accepts {client}. Nothing is contributed until vinyl-check is updated; the status and Disconnect keep working.
feature_unsupported: This server does not combine feature version {version} yet. Nothing is sent to it until it does.
detector_unsupported: This server does not combine detector version {version}. Nothing is contributed.
unreachable_note: The server could not be reached at the last attempt. The station keeps its local model and tries again later.
key_changed_note: The server now presents another key than the one accepted. Nothing more is sent to it. If its operator confirms the new key, disconnect and connect again.
revoked_note: The server's operator revoked this station. Connect again to join with a new key.
key_lost_note: This station's key file is missing (restored from a backup or deleted). Connect again.
model_candidate: Candidate {version}, checked and reported, not used yet
model_unused: Version {version}, not used: not better on your master recordings
model_idle: Version {version}, not in use: the imported starting point replaced it
prior_none: none, the training starts from zero
prior_inactive: not in use while Use the global model is off
prior_remove_confirm: Remove the starting point? The learning model is trained from zero again.
waiting_recording: A recording is running. Vinyl-Mind waits until it has finished.
send_now_hint: Send changed contributions and look for a newer global model now.
sync_withdrawn: The server withdrew the model in use; the station uses its own model again.
reconnect_hint: Connect this station again with a new key; the old one is disconnected.
reconnect_confirm: Connect this station again with a new key? You sign in once more; the old key is disconnected afterwards.
leave_confirm: Disconnect from this Vinyl-Mind server? It deletes this station and its contributions. Connecting again creates a new station key.
forget_confirm: The server could not be reached ({error}). Forget it on this station anyway?
preview_hint: Exactly these documents leave the station, one per turntable profile; the profile ID is only part of the address. The profile names are shown only here; audio, record titles and names are never sent.
files_hint: Without a server, knowledge can travel as files: export a profile's contribution here and import it on another station as its starting point. A global model saved from a server can be imported too.
imported: Imported. The learning model is retrained with it as the starting point.
